required_status_checks.context: Foundation / Academic static and unit gates

activationPreconditions: Receive a separate explicit GO to change GitHub ruleset 26665434, not just source PR merge authorization
Reinspect latest main, current GitHub Actions job identity and ruleset API schema
Verify ruleset editor privileges and an owner-controlled recovery runbook
Capture access-restricted before-state for rollback and verify permissions to restore it
Require successful three CI checks and resolve review conversations before each source merge
Confirm activating a zero-review PR rule can be enforced on the repository plan without bypassing CI
postActivationVerification: GET ruleset 26665434 reports active and default-branch scope with no bypass actors
GET branch main reports protected true and effective required checks
Test disposable pull request: zero approvals permitted only after three passing required checks
Test failed or missing required CI blocks merge; deletion and non-fast-forward blocked by policy
Reconcile dated R8A/R8B/R8C snapshot evidence and update security decision records only after observed success
limitations: Source-only candidate. No collaborator invitation, ruleset PATCH, Cloudflare action, hosted Supabase migration or production release.
